optional_root_layers.name: <part>_mask
optional_root_layers.job: mask layer plus its clipped detail layer (§3a)

naming.rule: every part carries its view-coded name per view (§3f)

shared.name: hands
shared.rule: shared libraries are locked; character files link them, never copy them (§3f)

source_sheet.rule: name the dated turnaround this rig was built from; the rig never silently drifts from its source sheet (§3f)

mouth_chart.rule: the symbol timeline IS the chart: one frame per mouth drawing, frame-accurate sync (§3c)

eye_system.clipping: eye_mask clips the pupil inside the eye shape
eye_system.rule: four-piece masked eye system per eye; pupil sits inside pupil_parent so gaze motion never disturbs the eye's registration; brows are separate symbols (§3b)

hands.rule: one generic-hands library per body plan, shared by every character on that plan (§1b/§3f)

arm_front.rule: front/back arm symbols, >=3 pose frames each (§3d)

arm_back.rule: front/back arm symbols, >=3 pose frames each (§3d)

torso_move.rule: recurring torso motion lives in this helper symbol, never keyframed ad hoc on the root (§3d)

legs.rule: one symbol, >=8 pose frames — a step/stance set, not a jointed chain (§3d)

rules.baked_shadows: forbidden - shadows are added in compositing only
rules.versioning: never overwrite a version; bump the version number
rules.root_stack: no loose art on the root timeline; a part that moves on its own is a symbol, or it doesn't ship (§3a)
rules.overlap_skirt: head/torso and limb roots carry an overlap skirt so rotation to the ROM extremes opens no seam; stray art riding a part is painted out or split into its own symbol (§3g)
rules.angle_mouths: mouths are authored per view as separate sets inside the mouth symbol's frame ranges (§3f)

network.budget_note: the measured production census for this tier (kit §1/§4) — the budget this scaffold is grown toward in build-out; the census above is the scaffold's own seed network
rules: One master peg per character; pegs are cheap, hierarchy is deep (kit §4).
Curve deformers are the hero joint; standard builds stay peg-and-substitution (kit §4).
Parts overlap under curve control instead of rotating as rigid cards — the Harmony answer to the neck-seam / thin-streak defects logged on the Dorowani rig v1.
Budget rig effort by screen time: hero builds run ~10x the standard network (kit §1).

head.rule: a head is a small angle chart (10 drawings on the measured hero build), not one drawing (kit §3)

eye_L.rule: eyes ship per angle (F/3Q/P) with 4 numbered lid variants per angle (kit §3)

brow_L.rule: expression lives in the drawing name (brow-3Q_Angry1), not in a separate file (kit §3)

eye_R.rule: eyes ship per angle (F/3Q/P) with 4 numbered lid variants per angle (kit §3)

brow_R.rule: expression lives in the drawing name (brow-3Q_Angry1), not in a separate file (kit §3)

mouth.rule: mouths run 44-48 drawings on a standard build, angle-coded: the Blair 10 per angle (F/3Q/P), the character's expression mouths per angle, numbered extra takes to the measured floor (kit §3)

hand_L.rule: the hand library lives inside the character template as a substitution chart; hero charts are measured at 105/107 drawings, standard charts stay small with hand_extra sets (kit §3)

hand_R.rule: the hand library lives inside the character template as a substitution chart; hero charts are measured at 105/107 drawings, standard charts stay small with hand_extra sets (kit §3)

palette.mode: LINKed single source — the palette file is linked into every scene and element, never embedded; one edit propagates everywhere (kit §5)
rules: Colour names are semantic and part-based (hair, skin, pants, tongue...); quoted names where a space is needed.
`rig` (alpha 0) paints rig-only marks that must never render; `Cutter` (pure green) is the matte colour the cutter nodes key on. Both ride in every palette.
Character colours come from the character's §2 palette sheet — this file is their single linked source.
